name: Weather
reason: Folks, with six scorching days above 30C and a 31.8C average high, this lake is basking in a near-perfect bloom setup, and only that 22.2 mm of rain keeps me from going higher.
evidence: Average max temperature 31.8C, well above the 30C bloom-favouring threshold
6 hot days this week, a sustained heat run that stratifies the water
22.2 mm total rain, moderate enough to cause some mixing and nutrient input but not a major flush
Mid-June timing, when the water is warming toward peak growth conditions
